verses.en: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
verses.pt: Irmãos, se alguém for surpreendido em algum pecado, vós que sois espirituais, restaurai ao tal com espírito de mansidão, prestando atenção a ti mesmo, para que não sejas tentado também.
verses.en_web: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
verses.en_bbe: Brothers, if a man is taken in any wrongdoing, you who are of the Spirit will put such a one right in a spirit of love; keeping watch on yourself, for fear that you yourself may be tested.

verses.en: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.pt: Levai as cargas uns dos outros, e assim cumprireis a lei de Cristo.
verses.en_web: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Take on yourselves one another's troubles, and so keep the law of Christ.

verses.en: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.pt: Pois, se alguém pensa ser alguma coisa, sendo nada, engana a si mesmo.
verses.en_web: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
verses.en_bbe: For if a man has an idea that he is something when he is nothing, he is tricked by himself.

verses.en: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.pt: Cada um, porém, examine a sua própria obra, e então terá orgulho em si mesmo sozinho, e não em outro;
verses.en_web: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
verses.en_bbe: But let every man make test of his work, and then will his cause for glory be in himself only, and not in his neighbour.

verses.en: For every man shall bear his own burden.
verses.pt: pois cada um levará a sua própria carga.
verses.en_web: For each man will bear his own burden.
verses.en_bbe: Because every man is responsible for his part of the work.

verses.en: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
verses.pt: Mas aquele que é instruído na palavra compartilhe todas as boas coisas com aquele que o instrui.
verses.en_web: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
verses.en_bbe: But let him who gets teaching in the word give a part in all good things to his teacher.

verses.en: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.pt: Não vos enganeis: Deus não se deixa escarnecer; pois, o que o ser humano semear, isso também colherá.
verses.en_web: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
verses.en_bbe: Be not tricked; God is not made sport of: for whatever seed a man puts in, that will he get back as grain.

verses.en: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
verses.pt: Pois quem semear para a sua carne, da carne colherá degradação; mas quem semear para o Espírito, do Espírito colherá a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: Because he who puts in the seed of the flesh will of the flesh get the reward of death; but he who puts in the seed of the Spirit will of the Spirit get the reward of eternal life.

verses.en: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.pt: Porém não cansemos de fazer o bem, pois no tempo devido colheremos, se não desistirmos.
verses.en_web: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
verses.en_bbe: And let us not get tired of well-doing; for at the right time we will get in the grain, if we do not give way to weariness.

verses.en: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.pt: Portanto, enquanto temos oportunidade, façamos o bem a todos; mas principalmente aos familiares da fé.
verses.en_web: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
verses.en_bbe: So then, as we have the chance, let us do good to all men, and specially to those who are of the family of the faith.

verses.en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verses.pt: Olhai como são grandes as letras que vos escrevi da minha mão.
verses.en_web: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
verses.en_bbe: See the size of the handwriting which I myself have made use of in writing to you.

verses.en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
verses.pt: Todos os que querem mostrar boa aparência na carne, estes vos obrigam a vos circuncidarem, somente para não serem perseguidos por causa da cruz de Cristo.
verses.en_web: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised; just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Those who have the desire to seem important in the flesh, put force on you to undergo circumcision; only that they may not be attacked because of the cross of Christ.

verses.en: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.pt: Pois nem mesmo os que se circuncidam guardam a Lei; mas querem que vos circuncideis, para se orgulharem de vossa carne.
verses.en_web: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.
verses.en_bbe: Because even those who undergo circumcision do not themselves keep the law; but they would have you undergo circumcision, so that they may have glory in your flesh.

verses.en: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verses.pt: Mas longe de mim esteja me orgulhar, a não ser na cruz do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo; por meio dela, o mundo está crucificado para mim, e eu para o mundo.
verses.en_web: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
verses.en_bbe: But far be it from me to have glory in anything, but only in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which this world has come to an end on the cross for me, and I for it.

verses.en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.pt: Pois em Cristo Jesus, nem a circuncisão tem valor algum, nem a incircuncisão; mas sim a nova criatura.
verses.en_web: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
verses.en_bbe: For having circumcision is nothing, and not having circumcision is nothing, but only a new order of existence.

verses.en: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.pt: E todos os que andarem conforme esta regra, paz e misericórdia estejam sobre eles, e sobre o Israel de Deus.
verses.en_web: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And on all who are guided by this rule be peace and mercy, and on the Israel of God.

verses.en: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
verses.pt: De agora em diante, ninguém me perturbe, porque trago no meu corpo as marcas do Senhor Jesus.
verses.en_web: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
verses.en_bbe: From this time on let no man be a trouble to me; because my body is marked with the marks of Jesus.

verses.en: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.pt: A graça do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o vosso espírito, irmãos. Amém! Escrita de Roma para os Gálatas
verses.en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. So be it.
